messages:
maria_docs: Quick heads-up — I'm starting a lightweight migration guide for the v1 -> v2 API and the upcoming embed model swap. Need owners for: code snippets (JS + Python), embed dim note, and a short breaking-change blurb for the SDK changelog.

sam_sdk: I can take the SDK changelog blurb and a JS snippet. Do we still prefer `model` -> `model_id` rename or are we switching to `model: 'redwood/v2-efficiency'` style?

maria_docs: For the guide text we'll call out the rename clearly; sample snippets should use the new `model_id` param to avoid ambiguity. But for quickstart we can show the literal model string `redwood/v2-efficiency` so users know the canonical model id.

jia_pm: FYI, product decided on a staged model swap: hosted traffic will point to v2 variants next Tuesday, but Dedicated customers get a 2-week opt-in window. Docs need a note about fallback behavior (v1 -> v2 auto-fallback disabled).

alex_eng: Re: fallback — infra will not auto-convert v1 requests. We'll provide a compat shim for simple cases, but we should avoid marketing that as guaranteed. I can add a small code snippet showing how to detect v1 usage and map to v2 with minimal changes.

leo_qa: I'll run smoke tests once PRs land. Please tag me on the PRs for snippets and the sample app. Also: embedding dim change — need a clear migration checklist for vector stores. I recommend a short section called "Embed vector compatibility" with a sample script to reindex.

maria_docs: Good call. Plan:
- sam_sdk: SDK changelog + JS snippet (due EOD tomorrow)
- alex_eng: compat shim example + short note about behavior (due Mon)
- leo_qa: test plan and reindex snippet (link to smoke harness)
- maria_docs: assemble guide, publish draft and ping #docs-review (due Tue morning)

sam_sdk: Draft blurb for changelog: `v2 SDK: renamed 'model' -> 'model_id' and tightened validation on streaming params. Users should update callsites and test streaming clients against the new param. See migration guide for examples.` Thoughts?

maria_docs: Clean. Add a single-line example of the old vs new call.

maria_docs: ```
// v1 (old)
client.generate({ model: 'redwood/v1-small', prompt: 'hello' })

// v2 (new)
client.generate({ model_id: 'redwood/v2-efficiency', prompt: 'hello' })
```

sam_sdk: Nice. Python snippet too?

maria_docs: Yeah, short one: ```py
# v2
resp = client.generate(model_id='redwood/v2-efficiency', prompt='hi')
```

alex_eng: For the compat shim snippet I'll add: check for `model` key and translate to `model_id`, but warn that streaming flags semantics changed. Include this comment: `# fallback only for simple requests; do not rely on this for production critical paths`.

maria_docs: Also flag this in the migration guide: streaming param `stream: true` behavior is stricter in v2 (explicit framing + message types). Recommend reading the streaming section and running local smoke test.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: docs branch `mig/v1-to-v2-guide` will run checks at 2024-11-06T09:00:00Z.

leo_qa: I'll add a small reindex script snippet for Postgres + pgvector and note the dimension bump: `ALTER table` + re-run ingestion. Example: ```sh
# reindex example (pseudo)
python reindex_vectors.py --source old_index --dest new_index --model redwood/v2-embed-xxl
```

jia_pm: Please include a short migration FAQ: will customer keys break? (No, keys remain valid), will latency change? (maybe; include perf callouts and link to model catalog).

maria_docs: Will do. One more question: should we add a deprecation banner for v1 endpoints in the API reference pages?

sam_sdk: Yes — a banner + link to migration guide. Keep wording mild: "v1 endpoints are scheduled for deprecation; see migration guide."

maria_docs: OK. I'll create the draft PR with all snippets and the banner copy. PR description will list owners above and include checklist for smoke tests. I'll ping everyone once it's up. :sparkles:

alex_eng: Ping me when PR is ready; I'll sanity-check the shim example.

leo_qa: Tag me for the smoke run.

maria_docs: Thanks all — target to land the PR by Tue AM so we have time before the staged swap.
